quiz.question: In Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) with Dart, what is the primary purpose of inheritance?

answers.answer: To define a new type of variable that can store multiple data types.
To allow a new class to reuse properties and methods from an existing class.
To create a loop that executes a block of code a specified number of times.
To combine multiple strings into a single string.

quiz.question: Which keyword is used in Dart to indicate that a class is inheriting from another class?

answers.answer: The Dog class implicitly creates an eat() method because it is an Animal.
The Dog class directly defines its own eat() method.
The Dog class inherits the eat() method from its Animal parent class.
eat() is a global function that can be called by any object.
